items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: But I never got to know Pha Terrell.

ctx.x: I liked their sound, and I liked their... They were so crisp. That's what I liked about Hal Kemp. They were together. There was nothin' sloppy about it. And yet, when Count Basie's first records came out with his big band, they were sloppier than hell, and I just loved 'em! They were rip-roaring, whorehouse stuff, you know. Like, the very first record that he made with that big band was "Swingin' At The Daisy Chain." Well, I didn't know what a daisy chain was from... I'm from Spokane! And all of a sudden, here…
And I'll always regret that I never got to meet Dick Wilson. I did get to know Don Byas pretty well. But I never got to know Pha Terrell. I did know Dan Grissom very
